note.zh-TW: 現行用語是開辦費，英文舊譯 organisation costs 列為別名。
note.en: The current Taiwanese term is 開辦費 (start-up costs); the older English organisation costs is kept as an alias.

definition.zh-TW:
公司成立時為登記、公證、開辦等事項付出的費用。

課程把它先列為遞延資產，之後依課程設定分 5 年直線攤銷到費用；現行台灣用語是開辦費。
definition.en:
Costs paid to register, notarise and set up the company when it is formed.

The course records them first as a deferred asset and then amortises them on a straight-line basis over five years, the course setting; the current Taiwanese term is 開辦費 (start-up costs).

example.zh-TW: 位置：資產負債表遞延資產區。支付時現金減少、設立費增加，現金流量表列在投資活動的取得非流動資產；每年攤銷時設立費減少、攤銷遞延資產增加。
example.en: Where it sits: the deferred assets section of the balance sheet. Paying reduces cash and increases this asset, shown under investing activities as payments to acquire non-current assets; each year’s amortisation reduces the balance and increases amortisation of deferred assets.

misconception.zh-TW: 以為列成資產表示這筆錢以後還拿得回來。它沒有可以變現的價值，只是把一次付出的費用分攤到幾年認列；攤銷完之後就從資產負債表消失。
misconception.en: Believing that showing it as an asset means the money can be recovered. It has no realisable value; it merely spreads a one-off payment over several years, and once fully amortised it disappears from the balance sheet.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IAS 38.69 規定開辦活動的支出在發生時認列為費用，不能列為資產。IFRS 對照的版面改用「設立費（費用化）」：支付當期的費用增加、之後各期不再攤銷，付出的現金也由投資活動改列營業活動。
ifrsNote.en: IAS 38.69 requires expenditure on start-up activities to be recognised as an expense when incurred; it cannot be capitalised. The IFRS comparison layout uses start-up costs (expensed) instead: the expense is higher in the year of payment, there is no later amortisation, and the cash paid moves from investing to operating activities.
